note: Rolling prairie and cropland around Bilby Ranch Lake west of Maryville, with primitive camping at gravel lots on the county roads around the edge of the area: this one on the west side at 250th Street, others in the southwest corner near Highway 46, on 240th Street to the north and on 250th Street to the east. None is at the lake. No facilities; spot length is not published. MDC's area page (read November 2026) says Highway 46 is closed east of the area for a Nodaway River bridge replacement - from the east, detour via Highway 113. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites', free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Five GIS camping points at four places around the perimeter, each on a gravel lot off a county road; pin on the west 250th St lot is right. One split candidate (SW corner, 2 spots near Hwy 46). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 12/21/2021 map shows Primitive Camping symbols at four lots around the boundary. GIS layer 27 has five points: 137 at the stored pin (40.36344,-95.17777, on the gravel lot at the west boundary road / 250th St - imagery shows a ~25x40 m gravel lot); 135 (40.33925,-95.17808) and 321 (40.33510,-95.17601) in the SW corner, beside lots 920 and 3011 off the boundary road near Highway 46; 136 (40.37574,-95.14286) in a field 150 m SW of lot 915 on 240th St (north edge); 138 (40.36034,-95.12629) in brush 150 m S of lot 916 on 250th St (east edge). All lots are gravel and reached on county gravel roads; MDC's lot layer marks them 'Allows_Trailers: No' (a towed-trailer flag; a 23-ft motorhome fits the west lot easily). Spot length unpublished (caveat in note).

SPLIT candidate (one): the SW corner, 2.7-3.2 km south of the pin with two camping spots (135, 321) on its own lots off the boundary road at Highway 46 - suggest 'Bilby Ranch Lake CA - Southwest' pinned at lot 920, 40.33943,-95.17833. The north (136) and east (138) spots are single spots - not proposed (one per spot is out).
PIN: stored 40.36344,-95.17777 = GIS point 137 and lot 2217 - correct.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - Bilby Ranch Lake is ~3 km east of the pin; the only water near the pin is the small pond (map pond 11) ~70 m SE across open grass - map-scale under ~5 acres, so a pond, no value.
PHONE: (816) 271-3100 on the area page matches.

ACCESS: area page notice - 'Starting on October 31, Highway 46 is to close east of Bilby Ranch and will remain closed for some time while they replace the bridge of the Nodaway River' (year not stated on the page; kept in the note as read November 2026).
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage, 14-day line and the run-together direction sentence dropped; the camping places and the closure kept.
